def: A layer that keeps a hidden state updated linearly by each input and reads its output from that state, with constant work per token.
Attention with the softmax replaced by a product of feature maps, so the sum over past tokens can be kept as a fixed-size state.
The positive function applied to queries and keys in linear attention, such as elu(x) + 1.
Computing a layer one token at a time with a fixed-size state, which is how linear attention and state-space layers generate text.
Making a state-space layer's update depend on the current input, so it can choose what to write into its state and what to ignore.
A state-space architecture with input-dependent updates, computed by a hardware-aware parallel scan.
An algorithm that computes a linear recurrence over a whole sequence in parallel instead of one step at a time.
The limit on how many independent facts a fixed-size state can hold, roughly its number of entries.
A state update that subtracts what the state already predicts for a key before writing the new value, letting it overwrite old information.
A model that mixes mostly recurrent or state-space layers with a few attention layers, to keep exact lookup at a smaller cache.
The result that Mamba-style layers and a form of attention are two views of the same structured matrices.
